name: Systemia Atlas Freight Load Exception Intelligence
intents: what is wrong with this load
audit this freight load for exceptions
check this carrier and load paperwork
find missing POD or rate mismatches
summarize freight risk on this shipment
what recoverable charges or detention issues exist
authority: public discovery of read-only freight exception intelligence within authorized organization scope

analysis does not authorize dispatch, quote acceptance, carrier contact, claim filing, payment or invoice action

organization-scoped or private freight records remain access controlled
